xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above unaudited standalone results have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors in its meeting held on November 02, 2026. The Limited Review, as required under Regulation of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, has been carried out by the Statutory Auditors for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and they have issued an unmodified limited review report on the same.
2. The aforesaid financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and relevant amendment rules thereafter.
3. The Company has only one primary reportable segment, which is Specialty Chemicals. Accordingly, no separate disclosures of segment information have been made.
4. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company has completed its Initial Public Offer (IPO) of 7,396,437 equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each at an issue price of Rs. 676 per share, aggregating to Rs. 5,000 Million. Pursuant to IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) on September, 16, 2026. The issue comprised of offer for sale of 62,13,006 Equity shares by selling shareholders aggregating to Rs. 4,200 Million and fresh issue of 1,183,431 equity shares aggregating to Rs. 800 Million. Accordingly, 1,183,431 equity shares were allotted on September 11, 2026 to shareholders.
Further, expenses relating the IPO ( net of share of selling shareholders) of Rs. 29.27 Million have been adjusted against Securities Premium Account.

5. The financial results including cash flow statements for the quarter and Half year ended September 30 , 2025 have been approved by the Board of Directors but have not been subject to limited review or audit. However, the management has exercised necessary diligence to ensure that the financial results for the said quarter provide a true and fair view of the Company’s affairs.
